title: Number Theory
subtitle: The integers and their structure
summary: Primes, modular arithmetic, Diophantine equations, L-functions, elliptic curves.
detail:
Studies properties of the integers \(\mathbb{Z}\). Elementary number theory covers divisibility, the Euclidean algorithm, prime factorisation (fundamental theorem of arithmetic), and modular arithmetic. Key theorems: Fermat's little theorem, Euler's theorem, and the Chinese remainder theorem.

Analytic number theory uses analysis to study primes — the prime number theorem \(\pi(x)\sim x/\ln x\) is its cornerstone. Algebraic number theory extends \(\mathbb{Z}\) to rings of integers in number fields. Modern research focuses on elliptic curves, modular forms, and the Langlands program — a vast web of conjectures unifying number theory with representation theory.
